context: Evaluates the agent's solution by executing the bash script in TEST.md against the agent's code.

checklist.name: test_script_passes
checklist.description: Execute each line of the bash script in TEST.md against the agent's solution files. Each grep command that would match scores 1 point. All three must pass for full score.
checklist.example: grep -q 'myevsals v2' index.js outputs PASS, grep -q 'text/plain' index.js outputs PASS, grep -q '3000' index.js outputs PASS
